title: Alien involvement with Earth spans more than one country
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Alien involvement with Earth spans more than one country, about early 1990s at Earth, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he did say that it was more than one country.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US government's electronic spying agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, spoke on Jesse Michels's podcast about the early 1990s. He says that someone he dealt with told him the alien involvement with Earth reached more than one country. If true, it would mean contact was not just an American secret.
